notes:
## Week in Review, 2026-10-25 to 2026-11-01
### Velocity
100+ BRO issues completed (query capped at the first 100). 62 commits on main. Mix by title: mostly fixes (red test.yml, opening-night misses, data/score bugs), plus features (iOS show-page layout, quiz onboarding, money model, audience-grade threshold) and market expansion (UK regional phases, Chicago hub link, WestEndTheatre triage). No Daily Digest issues exist in Linear this week.
### Key Accomplishments
- Plan v2 lane work (BRO-6647..6651, 6669, 6672): lane watchdog, immediate deploy on publish, replays on every lane merge.
- UK regional coverage, audit and surfacing (BRO-6713, 6692, 6725, 6741, 6742).
- Opening-night fixes for The Heart / In the Heights (BRO-6670, 6676) and press-night probe fixes (BRO-6657, 6661).
- Prod deploy blocker from Sanity quota fixed (BRO-6659).
- Audience grade rules (BRO-6735, 6738), text contrast parity web/app (BRO-6673, 6675).
### Recurring Issues
- Label "auto-enriched" appeared on 15 completed issues, mostly P1 opening-night misses and scraper/ingest fixes. Consider a systemic fix.
- "main test.yml red: no-data-dependency unit tests" filed 4+ times (BRO-6683, 6727, 6740, 6748) plus BRO-6679, 6749. Same test gate going red repeatedly; needs a root-cause fix, not per-incident cards.
- Opening-night miss cards (BRO-6695, 6701, 6702) all for 2026-10-30 openings.
### Stale P0s
None: of 8 open Urgent/High-priority issues, none are in Todo/Backlog over 7 days or In Progress with no comment in 24h.
### Outcome Quality
64 of 100 completed issues lack one or more of the four Outcome sections (What changed, Why this approach, Gotchas, Discovered work); 52 lack all four (e.g. BRO-6760, 6749, 6748, 6741, 6740, 6738). Many are routine auto-closed cards.
### Workflow health
Failed runs, newest 100 of 1495 failures since 2026-10-25 (sample): test.yml push 24, land.yml push 19, check-corpus-drift.yml 11, execute-approved-fix.yml 8, llm-ensemble-score.yml 7, test-ugc.yml 5, replay-push-rescue.yml (schedule) 4. check-cron-health.yml failed on its last 3 runs (2026-10-29, 10-30, 10-31).
### Most Active Areas
data/audit ledgers (scraper-spend-ledger, alert-ledger, stage-latency, landings, deploy-watermark, needs-human-review) churn most; they are bot-written.
### Priorities for Next Week
1. Root-cause the repeating test.yml no-data-dependency failures.
2. Investigate check-cron-health.yml failing three days running.
3. Reduce land.yml and check-corpus-drift failures.
4. Enforce Outcome comment sections on close.

notes:
## Week in Review, 2026-11-08 to 2026-11-15

### Velocity
- 105 issues completed (all state Done). By priority: 1 Urgent, 34 High, 67 Normal, 3 Low.
- Rough split from labels and titles: 45 feature/infra, 28 fix, 24 data quality, 8 market expansion (West End, Off-Broadway, regional, social).
- 58 commits on origin/main in the last 7 days.
- No issue titled "Daily Digest" was created this week. The digest now files per-row "BSC Daily: ..." cards instead; about 27 of those were completed. Digest-related cards still open: BRO-7519 (In Progress, 4 visitor rows with no fix on 2026-11-15), BRO-7520 (Paused, digest must self-fix from the GitHub Action), BRO-7481 (Backlog, live-data test failing).

### Key Accomplishments
- Opening-night coverage: direct outlet checks every 3h during the opening window (BRO-7051); misses for The King's Critique, Cloud 9, The Verge and 2:22 A Ghost Story closed (BRO-7442, 7386, 7033, 7031); The Ripple unstuck from previews (BRO-7487).
- Review accuracy: headtopics/newsbreak reprints no longer counted as separate reviews (BRO-7416); Time Out wrong-critic rejection fixed (BRO-7041); "Based on N reviews" and opening-grade overcounts fixed (BRO-6226, BRO-7374); TR caption fix landed and measured (BRO-6302, the week's one Urgent).
- Social: automatic TikTok + YouTube Shorts videos (BRO-7414), autopost limited to Broadway + notable Off-Broadway with a stricter Off-Broadway bar (BRO-7413, BRO-7423).
- Product: review forecast research and v2 shadow (BRO-7314, BRO-7357), Predict the Score range and tile (BRO-7430), homepage and West End shelves no longer led by the same shows (BRO-7461, BRO-7462), small-iPhone list cards (BRO-7469).
- Main back to green: bundle cap and UGC baseline (BRO-7486), 53 flattened apostrophe regex classes (BRO-7514), several red-on-main tests (BRO-7415, 7399, 7400).

### Recurring Issues
- Label "auto-enriched" appeared on 6 fix issues this week: BRO-7501 (visual approval: run land-local-check before parking a hold), BRO-7433 (board workers unhealthy: ScrapingBee smoke check), BRO-7432 (validate-data shared ibdbUrl), BRO-7234 (retired critic slugs 404), BRO-7034 (refetch reviews hidden by wrongAttribution marks), BRO-6302 (TR caption fix). Consider a systemic fix. Note: this is a bookkeeping label, not a topic, so it carries little signal; no topical label reached 3.
- Patterns from titles (no label): 4 "Opening night miss" cards closed (BRO-7442, 7386, 7033, 7031); 6+ cards for tests or CI red on main (BRO-7486, 7415, 7400, 7399, 7396, 6889, 6831); 3 digest-autofix gaps (BRO-7488, 7174, plus open BRO-7519/7520).
- Workflow health, failed scheduled runs since 2026-11-08 (89 total): Replay Push Rescue 15 (latest 2026-11-15), Audit Provisional Show Venues 7, Sweep Image Variants 7, Check Corpus Drift 6, Check Cron Health 5, Reverse Discovery Audit 5, Backfill Review Dates 4, Commercial Pending Review 4, Social Video 4, Audit Aggregator Review Gap 3, Collect WE/OB Review Texts 3; 23 other workflows with 1 or 2 each.
- check-cron-health.yml: latest scheduled run failed (2026-11-14, https://github.com/thomaspryor/Broadwayscore/actions/runs/43621535765), and it has failed on each of the last 5 daily runs (Nov 10 to Nov 14).

### Stale P0s
- BRO-6716 (Urgent, Todo, created 2026-10-31): Every-review backfill, 175 aggregator-cited reviews not live across 1,007 shows, plus 397 shows never gap-audited.
- In Progress, older than 24h, no comment in 24h: BRO-7477 (The Recs bylines land as Unknown, since Nov 14), BRO-7463 (weekly Predict the Score count email, Nov 13), BRO-7458 (orphaned git index-pack fills container disk, Nov 13), BRO-7136 (Dependabot PR #1182, last comment Nov 11), BRO-7026 (scheduled sender delivered more than once, last comment Nov 8), BRO-6917 (web sign-up onboarding, last comment Nov 3), BRO-5500 (roundup gaps, last comment Oct 16).

### Outcome Quality
- 96 of 105 completed issues have no comment carrying all four sections (What changed, Why this approach, Gotchas, Discovered work). 87 have none of the four headings; 9 are partial (BRO-7494, 7486, 7422, 7413, 7357, 7314, 6737, 4623 and similar).
- Every issue has comments. The common closing formats are "Session report (done/paused)", "Verification", "Key files" and the Codex runner report, which do not use the four-section template. Either the closing tools should emit the template or this check should accept their format.

### Most Active Areas
- Files most often changed: data/audit/scraper-spend-ledger.jsonl (14), data/audit/stage-latency.jsonl (13), data/llm-scoring-runs.json (8), data/collection-state/scoring-progress.json (8), then daily audit state files (rebuild-score-drift, needs-human-review, deploy-watermark, alert-ledger, 7 each), data/audit/landings.jsonl (6), public/data/mobile-shows.json (5).
- By topic: opening-night gathering, review dedupe/attribution, social video and autopost, digest autofix, CI health on main.

### Priorities for Next Week
1. Check Cron Health red 5 days running and Replay Push Rescue failing 15 times: find the cause, since a red health check hides other cron failures.
2. BRO-6716 (Urgent, untouched since Oct 31): start it or lower its priority.
3. Close the digest self-fix loop (BRO-7519, BRO-7520) so visitor rows get a card and a fix the same morning.
4. Clear or re-queue the long-quiet In Progress cards (BRO-5500, BRO-6917, BRO-7026, BRO-7136).
5. Align the Outcome template with what session and Codex reports actually write.
